The '''Imperial Education Center''' was an education center in [[Vaklin Zenith]] built in order to erase [[Vaklin]]'s honor of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Vaklin insurgency]].
